name: Beltelecom Regional Data Center Brest
notes: Beltelecom's official data-center page says it built data centers in all regional cities of Belarus in 2007 and provides colocation from those regional DPCs; Datacenters.com identifies the Brest regional facility.

name: Beltelecom central data center, Zakharova 55
notes: Beltelecom says the first Belarus data center was built in 2006 at its international switching center and that the central DPC at Zakharova 55 was expanded in 2014; third-party directories list the Minsk facility at vul. Zacharava 55.

name: Beltelecom second Minsk data center, Uborevicha 8/2
notes: Beltelecom's official data-center history states that a second Minsk DPC site was launched in December 2009 at ul. Uborevicha 8/2.

name: A1 Data Center Minsk
notes: A1 says it launched its Minsk data center in September 2017; the facility spans 7,500 sq m, is designed for 800 racks, and holds Uptime Institute Tier III Design and Facility, PCI DSS, and ISO/IEC 27001 certifications. Baxtel lists it among Belarus' largest data centers.

name: MTS Belarus Minsk data center
notes: DCD reported MTS Belarus opened a Tier III-standard Minsk data center in 2021 with 370 sq m, 78 rack places, and total electrical capacity of 954 kW for MTS Cloud and customer IaaS.

name: DataHata Minsk data center
notes: DataHata's official site describes it as the first commercial data center in Belarus, located in Minsk at Sharangovicha 19, with colocation, server rental and VPS services.

name: MDA Data Center, High Tech Park Minsk
notes: MDA's official data-center site says the DPC is a dedicated two-story, approximately 1,000 sq m building in the Belarus High Tech Park at Programmistov 11, Minsk, with a 64-rack machine hall and colocation/VPS/dedicated-server services.

name: Beltelecom Regional Data Center Gomel
notes: Beltelecom officially reports regional DPCs in all Belarus regional cities; Datacenters.com identifies the Gomel regional facility within Beltelecom's national data-center network.

name: Beltelecom Regional Data Center Grodno
notes: Beltelecom officially reports regional DPCs in all Belarus regional cities; Datacenters.com identifies the Grodno regional facility within Beltelecom's national data-center network.

name: Beltelecom Regional Data Center Mogilev
notes: Beltelecom officially reports regional DPCs in all Belarus regional cities; Datacenters.com identifies the Mogilev regional facility within Beltelecom's national data-center network.

name: beCloud Republican Data Processing Center, Kolodishchi
notes: beCloud's official page describes the Republican Data Processing Center as one of Belarus' largest complexes and first Tier III DPC, with 624 rack capacity, 3,200 sq m of IT space and 7.2 MW final project power. The official access-regulation page gives the address as Kolodishchi, Centralnaya 22 in Minsk District.

name: Beltelecom Regional Data Center Vitebsk
notes: Beltelecom officially reports regional DPCs in all Belarus regional cities; Datacenters.com identifies the Vitebsk regional facility within Beltelecom's national data-center network.
